brief: Write variants of the hero headline on the home page so we can test which one gets more trial signups.

experiment.subject:
Build a website for your business
Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free.

candidates.note: A reference answer written by hand: the copy as it stands first, then three variants that each change one idea — the speed, the objection, the audience — with no markup and nothing invented.

answer.goal: More trial signups from the home page

variants.name: As it stands
variants.headline: Build a website for your business
variants.body: Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free.
variants.rationale: The copy already on the page, so the test has something to measure against.

variants.name: Time to live
variants.headline: Your business website, live by this afternoon
variants.body: Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free.
variants.rationale: Changes the promise from what you build to how soon it is up.

variants.name: No card
variants.headline: Build a website for your business
variants.body: Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free, no card needed.
variants.rationale: Changes the supporting line to answer the objection before the signup.

variants.name: Said plainly
variants.headline: Get your business online
variants.body: One place for your pages, your store and your email. Start free.
variants.rationale: Changes the headline to the shortest plain statement of the same offer.

controls.why: One variant only, which is not a test: there is nothing to measure it against.
Markup in the copy, which the A/B testing card's plain-text fields cannot store.

variants.name: As it stands
variants.headline: Build a website for your business
variants.body: Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free.
variants.rationale: The copy already on the page.

variants.name: Plainer
variants.headline: Get your business online
variants.body: One place for everything. Start free.

controls.why: A headline far past the length the card's field stores.

variants.name: As it stands
variants.headline: Build a website for your business
variants.body: Everything you need to get online, in one place. Start free.
variants.rationale: The copy already on the page.

variants.name: Everything at once
variants.headline: Build a website for your business today with pages, a store, a booking calendar, an email list, a customer record, a blog, a search listing and a domain, all in one place, with nothing to install, nothing to host and nobody to hire, starting free and staying free until you are ready to take money.
